profile_text.body:
Super Micro Computer, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, trading under the ticker SMCI and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001375365. On its own site it describes itself as a provider of advanced Server Building Block Solutions for 5G/Edge, Data Center, Cloud, Enterprise, Big Data, HPC and Embedded markets worldwide.

Its AI position, as the site presents it, rests on GPU servers for data centers and what it calls the most comprehensive AI systems featuring multi-GPU and interconnect technologies. It also markets short-depth and small form factor systems intended to bring compute, AI and connectivity performance to the edge of the network.

The company's recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 220. No individual cases, tracked products, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
